global_rules.R: Plausible standing reader opportunity for the selected package after prerequisite, alternative-resource, language and modality overlap discounts; not gross population, predicted downloads, causal learning gains, or a statistical identification interval.
global_rules.range_semantics: Low/base/high are defensible planning judgments, not confidence limits or proven positive lower bounds. The measured-only estimand remains unknown. No default percentage is multiplied into a census population.
global_rules.non_overlap: R is already residual. N is an explanatory overlap descriptor, not an additional numerical discount applied to R.
